name: Sample service
description: A plugin the test suite installs the way a user installs one: settings (one of them secret), a set-up script, a pipeline harness, a connector, skills, actions and schedule templates. The service it names (example.org) does not exist.
author: KimiLM tests

settings.label: API key
settings.help: The service's key. It starts with sk_sample_.

settings.label: Publish as
settings.help: Press 'Check and connect' to load your choices.

settings.label: Submit automatically
settings.help: On: finished work is submitted. Off: it stays as a draft.

settings.label: Import from a folder (optional)
settings.help: A folder with earlier notes to bring over.

connectors.name: Sample service
connectors.description: The service account: items, publishing and comments.

schedule_templates.name: Weekly summary
schedule_templates.prompt: Using the Sample service connector, summarise last week's items and new comments.
